[***Demographic Research***]{.journal} · 2021

\[[Article](https://www.demographic-research.org/volumes/vol45/18/default.htm)\]

## \> *New method to estimate annual populations of each region and deduce annual migration flows. A large proportion of the population (up to 60%) was displaced from the north to the south in 1940–41. The demarcation line did not prevent population movements. Demographic scars of war were still present in 1946.*
